subject: Commitment orchestration map: AWS & GCP billing lane alignment
messages:
From: Erin Wu <erin.wu@brightlane.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cruz <daniel.cruz@brightlane.com>, AWS Marketplace Rep <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — routing billing & private offer questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Procurement pulled together a short list of clarifying questions so we can align our internal legal & finance milestones with the marketplace private offer path. High-level asks:

- Confirm the billing lane for an AWS Marketplace private offer (do we get an AWS invoice or a Redwood consolidated invoice?)
- If we go AWS private offer, what are the milestone checkpoints you need from our procurement/legal to trigger commitment activation?
- For a potential GCP private offer (we use both clouds), can you sketch a parallel MAP we can share with stakeholders?

I attached our internal procurement cadence (RL-BrightLane-MAP-v1.xlsx). Can we get a short MAP that lists owners, deliverables, and a realistic close timeline (target: Jan 15, 2027)?

Thanks — Erin
Erin Wu
VP Finance, BrightLane Health

Attachment: RL-BrightLane-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Erin Wu <erin.wu@brightlane.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — routing billing & private offer questions

Erin —

Appreciate the clear asks and the spreadsheet. Quick answers up front:

- AWS Marketplace private offers typically route billing to AWS (you get an AWS invoice) if transacted via Marketplace; however, Redwood can support a consolidated billing arrangement in parallel for enterprise customers through a marketplace-managed "seller-managed billing" flow.
- Our recommended MAP (attached) separates procurement checkpoints from activation tasks so legal/finance can approve without blocking technical onboarding. Key owner roles: BrightLane procurement (you), BrightLane legal (Daniel), Redwood Sales (me), Redwood Finance (Ben), Redwood Marketplace Ops (Jordan).
- I sketched GCP parity in the same MAP; GCP private offers follow a similar pattern but use different billing SKUs and require a separate partner ticket (we'll open it).

I attached a draft MAP and a short term-sheet for the AWS private offer (aws-private-offer-term-sheet.pdf). Highlights of the MAP timeline:

1) Procurement approval packet (BrightLane) — due Nov 24
2) Legal review & term redlines (BrightLane + Redwood) — due Dec 8
3) Marketplace private-offer submission & partner acceptance (Redwood + cloud partner) — due Dec 20
4) Billing route confirmation & invoicing mockup (Redwood Finance + BrightLane Finance) — due Jan 3
5) Commitment activation & SOW signature (DocuSign) — target Jan 15

Putting this in an email so we have a shared reference. I expect 4–6 week lead time for marketplace acceptance if we avoid non-standard commercial terms. If BrightLane needs a consolidated Redwood invoice, I'll flag that with our finance ops and add a milestone for contract amendment.

Next step: Jordan will coordinate the marketplace tickets; Ben will run a billing mock with finance and produce a sample invoice. I can host a 30-minute sync with your procurement & legal on Thursday Nov 13 — does 10am PT work?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference
---
Attachments: RL-BrightLane-MAP-v1.xlsx (attached copy), aws-private-offer-term-sheet.pdf (PDF)

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Erin Wu <erin.wu@brightlane.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — routing billing & private offer questions

Following up with the ops side notes so the MAP is actionable for the cloud teams: 

- AWS path: We'll submit the private offer via AWS Marketplace Partner Central. AWS issues you an invoice for the contracted SKUs. If BrightLane requires vendor-level invoicing from Redwood, we can request an AWS "buyer-managed invoice" exception but that often adds 1–2 weeks for finance validation.
- GCP path: GCP private commitment requires a partner billing arrangement and an internal partner ticket (we'll open with GCP Partner Desk once BrightLane confirms), and GCP invoices usually flow through Google Cloud billing account. For a consolidated Redwood invoice on GCP, we need a reseller arrangement (longer lead time).
- Tech handoff: To avoid delays, recommend BrightLane attach an approximate monthly usage profile to the procurement packet (we can accept ranges). That helps marketplace ops size the private offer and avoid SKU rework.

I've created a short ops checklist and added it to the MAP spreadsheet under a new tab (technical-ops-checklist). I'll share a Drive link after the sync. For now, confirms: Jordan (Marketplace Ops) will create the AWS private-offer ticket Dec 1 if procurement packet is complete by Nov 24.

-Jordan
Marketplace Operations, Redwood Inference

Kimberly/Jordan —

Quick note from legal/procurement: the draft term sheet looks good but we have two asks that could change timeline slightly:

1) We need a one-way data-processing appendix and attestations for audit log retention (SOC2) before we finalize terms. Can Redwood provide the DPA draft and a sample SOC2 extract?
2) For billing, BrightLane's procurement prefers a single vendor invoice for budget and SOX controls. If the AWS path forces us to accept AWS invoices, we need a written description of how Redwood will map SKU charges to our GL accounts (sample invoice mock helps).

If those two items are provided by Nov 24 we should be able to keep the timeline; otherwise expect +2 weeks. We can join the Thurs 10am PT sync.

Thanks,
Daniel Cruz
Sr. Counsel, BrightLane Health

Erin/Daniel — thanks for the clear asks and for committing time on the sync yesterday. Quick status update and next actions: 

- DPA & SOC2 extract: Attached (BrightLane_SOW_v1.pdf includes a DPA appendix; I also attached a short SOC2 extract). Our security team is available for a 30‑minute Q&A with your security lead next week.
- Billing mock: Ben attached a one-page invoice mock (PDF) to this thread and flagged the GL mapping fields. That mock shows how charges will appear if routed through AWS; if you want a consolidated Redwood invoice we can produce a separate sample and include it in the DocuSign SOW amendment.
- Marketplace tickets: Jordan opened the AWS private-offer ticket today and set expected acceptance by Dec 18. GCP partner ticket will be opened once you confirm the preferred billing lane for that cloud.
- DocuSign: I've created the SOW draft and pushed it to DocuSign (link below). If legal approves the DPA wording we can request signatures and aim for activation by Jan 15 as discussed.

Docs and links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/3948 | https://www.docusign.net/contract/rl-3948-sign

I'll keep this thread updated as Jordan and Ben have ops/finance updates. Appreciate the collaboration — we'll hold the Jan 15 activation target if the Nov 24 procurement checkpoint is complete.

—Kim
